BiblicalUsage: With is the word for standing beside someone, and the Bible uses it for loyalty that stays. In 1 Samuel 10:2 Samuel tells Saul his father has left the asses and sorrows for you, in Deuteronomy 5:31 God tells Moses, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee, and in 2 Samuel 19:33 the king says to Barzillai, come thou over with me, and I will feed thee with me in Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the word is about presence: God asked Moses to stand with him, and David asked Barzillai to come with him, and I want to be the one who stays beside.
RelatedEvents: The Ten Commandments; Anointing of Saul as King
